title: ATP Core Test Vectors (machine-readable)
source: draft-bates-atp-test-vectors-00; entries marked proposed-01 are candidates for draft-bates-atp-test-vectors-01

conventions.canonicalization: ATP §9 null-member omission (recursive) followed by RFC 8785 JCS
conventions.nodeId: lowercase hex SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 bytes, nodeId and signature removed first
conventions.signatureMessage: 32 raw bytes of nodeId (bytes.fromhex(nodeId)), not the hex string
conventions.signatureEncoding: base64 (RFC 4648 §4: A-Za-z0-9+/, exactly 88 chars with == padding, no whitespace; canonical trailing bits)
conventions.payloadHashFormat: "sha256:" + 64 lowercase hex; nodeId/parents stay bare lowercase hex; any other form rejected
conventions.timestampFormat: exactly 20 chars YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ (uppercase T/Z, no fraction; calendar-checked)
conventions.validationResult: §13.6 keys including lineageIncomplete (disjoint from verified; empty in tip mode)

canonicalization.description: string escaping: non-ASCII raw, control chars \u00XX, DEL raw
key sort by UTF-16 code units (differs from code-point order)
empty string, empty array, empty object values
object emptied by null removal stays {}

nodeId.description: completion node with actor and parent reference
same content as V1 with mis-ordered keys
node with profile field (urn:ietf:params value is canonicalization-only; not a registered identifier; ATP defines no urn:ietf:params namespace)
V1 with nodeId and signature present: both MUST be stripped (§10.1)
V4 with parent order reversed: different nodeId (§8)
V1 with timestamp "+00:00" instead of "Z": same instant, different nodeId

negative.description: signature computed over the 64-char hex STRING of V1 nodeId instead of its 32 raw bytes; MUST fail verification
S1 with first signature byte flipped; MUST fail verification
S3 (signed with test-key-2) verified against test-key-1; MUST fail
valid S1 signature, message nodeId with last nibble altered; MUST fail
S1 with non-canonical S (S+L); MUST fail verification
non-canonical public key A (encoded y >= p); MUST fail verification
non-canonical R (encoded y >= p) with S=0; MUST fail verification
small-order public key A (identity) with R=identity and S=0; MUST fail even though the plain equation holds
small-order R (identity) with S=(k*a) mod L so the plain equation holds for test-key-1; MUST fail
S1 with padding omitted (86 chars, no ==); MUST reject strict base64
S1 with embedded line break in signature; MUST reject strict base64
S1 with trailing newline; MUST reject strict base64 (pre-fix Node/Python split)
S1 with leading space; MUST reject strict base64 (pre-fix Node/Python split)
S1 with trailing space; MUST reject strict base64 (pre-fix Node/Python split)
S1 in URL-safe base64 (-_ instead of +/); MUST reject strict alphabet (pre-fix Node/Python split)
S1 with extra padding (=); MUST reject (pre-fix Node/Python split)
S1 truncated to 87 chars; MUST reject (pre-fix Node/Python split)
S1 with one extra alphabet char (89 chars); MUST reject (pre-fix Node/Python split)

timestampFormat.description: space instead of T; MUST reject
+00:00 offset instead of Z; MUST reject
Arabic-Indic digits in year; MUST reject (ASCII [0-9] only)

ijson.description: duplicate member name at top level; MUST reject
duplicate member name nested in object; MUST reject
unpaired surrogate \ud800 in string; MUST reject at parse
number 1e400 outside IEEE-754 double; MUST reject
underflow 1e-400 converts to 0; MUST reject (non-zero mantissa)
zero literal 0e-400 is accepted (mantissa has no non-zero digit)
smallest positive denormal 5e-324 is a non-zero double; MUST accept

structural.description: uppercase hex in parents; MUST reject
structural.error: parent is not a lowercase hex SHA-256 nodeId: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA

structural.description: empty parents array is valid structurally
bare hex inputHash (no sha256: prefix); MUST reject
structural.error: inputHash must be sha256: + 64 lowercase hex

structural.description: uppercase hex in inputHash; MUST reject
structural.error: inputHash must be sha256: + 64 lowercase hex

structural.description: unknown hash prefix sha512:; MUST reject
structural.error: inputHash must be sha256: + 64 lowercase hex

structural.description: parents is not an array (string); MUST reject and MUST NOT default to []
parents entry wrong length (63 hex chars); MUST reject
parents entry 64 hex chars plus trailing newline; MUST reject (fullmatch)

payloadHashFormat.description: bare hex is not a payload hash
uppercase hex after sha256: is invalid

validation.description: full recursive validation of V4 with all heritage and keys
tip validation of V4 alone: parents are not resolved; tip never reports lineageIncomplete
full validation with V1 absent: V1 unresolved, V2 and V4 lineageIncomplete (not verified)
redacted mode with V1 declared withheld: withheld gap OK, children verified, NOT lineageIncomplete
full validation with V1 declared withheld and absent: withheld, children lineageIncomplete
full validation without test-key-2: V4 keyUnresolved (not invalid)
bounded validation, depth 0: parents reported outOfHorizon
full validation with V2 tampered: V4 lineageIncomplete (not verified)
redacted mode with V1 present but invalid (tampered): children lineageIncomplete, not verified
tip mode with broken heritage available: tip still verified, lineageIncomplete empty
tip validation of V5, unknown profile, permissive
tip validation of V5, unknown profile, strict
